map.逐项判定：密封泄漏率≤0.1%、耐压≥16MPa、拧紧扭矩 100~200N·m: Item-by-item: seal leakage rate ≤ 0.1%, withstand pressure ≥ 16 MPa, tightening torque 100~200 N·m; all three satisfied = pass. Excess leakage causes internal leak; insufficient pressure bursts; improper torque loosens or snaps.
map.密封泄漏率 0.05%（≤0.1 ✓）、耐压 18MPa（≥16 ✓）、扭矩 1: Leakage rate 0.05% (≤0.1 ✓), pressure 18 MPa (≥16 ✓), torque 150 N·m (range ✓): all three pass → qualified. If torque rises to 220 N·m it fails, beyond spec and easy to snap.

map.扭矩区间为何重要？: Why is the torque range important?
